speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Temporarily shutting down the turbines during peak migration periods would greatly reduce the risk of bird collisions.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: This would allow migratory birds to pass through the area with far less risk.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Seasonal shutdowns would be a strong precautionary measure and would significantly reduce the environmental risk to migratory birds.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: The downside is that the turbines would produce no energy during the shutdown periods.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: The overall reduction in production should be limited, however, and remains manageable within our renewable energy targets.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD
text: From the perspective of tourism, the shutdowns have little effect on the appearance of the wind park.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD
text: We therefore have no major objection to this measure.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: This option provides strong protection for SDG 15 while causing only a limited reduction in energy production and little impact on tourism.
